notes: New: your devices now find each other through Nostr relays first, with Tawny's own service as the backup, so pairing no longer depends on one server
New in Servers: use your own relays, see which ones work, or use only your relays
Fixed: on newer Linux systems the AppImage could not start the microphone or the Monitor's camera
Security: an expired pairing code, or an old QR code, can no longer be used to connect
